canonical.title: IT Conferences & Tech Events in London, 2026

parent.title: A Weekend in London: African-Cuisine Michelin Stars + City Playbook

siblings.title: Things to do in London
siblings.summary: A curated June 2026 weekend in London — iconic sights, free museums, walkable neighborhoods with markets, West End picks, parks, and the events worth planning around.

siblings.title: London's African-cuisine Michelin restaurants
siblings.summary: London's four Michelin-recognised West African restaurants — Ikoyi (2-star, 2026 world best), Akoko (1-star), Chishuru (1-star, £45 lunch), and Akara (Bib Gourmand) — with prices, booking tips, and signature dishes.

sources.title: London Tech Week
sources.claim: London Tech Week 2026 runs June 8-12 at Olympia London, with expo/content stages June 8-10 and fringe events across London June 8-12

sources.title: Infosecurity Europe
sources.claim: Infosecurity Europe 2026 runs June 2-4 at ExCeL London; free passes cost £49+VAT from 5 May onward; 13,000+ attendees and 380+ exhibitors expected

sources.title: AI Native DevCon 2026
sources.claim: AI Native DevCon 2026 is a 2-day in-person conference on June 1-2 at The Brewery, Barbican, covering agentic AI, context engineering, and agent security

sources.title: PyData London 2026
sources.claim: PyData London 2026 runs June 5-7 at Convene Sancroft, St. Paul's, with tutorials on Friday and talks Saturday-Sunday

sources.title: London's Calling
sources.claim: London's Calling 2026 is Europe's largest community-led Salesforce event, held 5 June at The Brewery, 52 Chiswell St, London EC1Y 4SA

sources.title: NDC London
sources.claim: NDC London 2026 ran January 26-30 at QEII Convention Centre, Westminster; a 5-day developer conference with 90+ international speakers

sources.title: QCon London
sources.claim: QCon London 2026 ran March 16-19 at QEII Centre; 3-day in-person pass costs £2,690

sources.title: Tech Show London
sources.claim: Tech Show London ran March 4-5 at ExCeL London; free for technology end-users; 19,000+ attendees, 700+ speakers

sources.title: ContainerDays London
sources.claim: ContainerDays London + MCPconference ran February 11-12 at The Truman Brewery

sources.title: DevOpsCon London
sources.claim: DevOpsCon London 2026 ran May 11-15 at Park Plaza Victoria and QEII Centre; 2-day pass from £989

sources.title: Devoxx UK
sources.claim: Devoxx UK 2026 ran May 6-7 at Business Design Centre, Upper Street, N1; £649+VAT for 2-day

sources.title: AWS Summit London
sources.claim: AWS Summit London 2026 was April 22 at ExCeL London; free to attend; 200+ expert-led sessions

sources.title: Gartner Data & Analytics Summit
sources.claim: Gartner Data & Analytics Summit London 2026 took place May 11-13; theme: Value at AI velocity

sources.title: Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit
sources.claim: Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit London 2026 runs September 22-24 at ExCeL London

sources.title: Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies
sources.claim: Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies Conference 2026 is scheduled November 16-17 in London

sources.title: AI World Congress
sources.claim: AI World Congress 2026 runs June 23-24 at Kensington Conference and Events Centre; tickets from £495; 100+ speakers

sources.title: LDX3 London (LeadDev)
sources.claim: LDX3 London (LeadDev + StaffPlus + LeadingEng) runs June 2-3 at InterContinental London O2; focused on engineering leadership for 2,500+ attendees
